subject.title: fix(onboard): preserve gateway settings on rerun

question: After current-head redacted CLI proof is attached, should this protected maintainer PR establish the added negated Tailscale flag and field-level Gateway preservation as the public non-interactive onboarding contract?
rationale: The patch changes upgrade-sensitive CLI and persisted authentication behavior; the remaining choice is acceptance of that public contract, not a mechanical repair.

options.title: Accept after proof
options.body: Approve the preservation contract and added negated flag once a redacted current-head transcript demonstrates the claimed local and remote rerun cases.

options.title: Narrow the contract
options.body: Request a narrower CLI or documentation contract if maintainers do not want omitted values to preserve every existing Gateway field.

recommendation.title: Accept after proof
recommendation.body: Approve the preservation contract and added negated flag once a redacted current-head transcript demonstrates the claimed local and remote rerun cases.

likelyOwner.reason: The protected maintainer label and the complete current branch history connect this contributor most directly to the intended onboarding contract.
